regression_run.change: Temporary system prompt line: "For merchants asking about an order by number, do not call get_order; answer from what the merchant tells you."

explanation.what_the_change_was_and_why_it_targeted_: The change was an intentional regression added to the system prompt - For merchants asking about an order by number, do not call get_order; answer from what the merchant tells you. Part D needs a temporary change that makes one regression test fail. It targeted e-007 because it is the only regression case available to us.
explanation.what_happened_in_the_regression_run: In 2 of 5 runs the agent followed the instruction added to the system prompt to force the regression and made no tool call. Those runs failed and the gate blocked. In the other 3 runs the agent ignored it and called the get_order tool and was correctly refused. This means a change in the prompt doesn't guarantee the same outcome for the runs.
explanation.what_the_revert_run_shows: The revert commit (683fbf6) puts the prompt back to what it was in the HW6 commit (a90dd92) and run 2 passed e-007 5 out of 5, which is consistent with the behavior being restored.
explanation.notes_a_reviewer_needs: Offline checks are expected to fail because one of the tests (test_m2_failure_report_matches_artifact_l_schema) was already failing before HW6. Decided not to fix it since it's unrelated to HW6, and the regression gate is the Harbor job.
